The large majority of our Gi³ team members are scientists and engineers. Gi³ team then offers specific related knowledge and added value consultancy. This expertise allows our clients to take advantage of various incentives and grants related to their priorities in terms of Research & Development [R&D], innovation and sustainability. We are principally a UK-based team with colleagues in the Deloitte USI at Bangalore and are looking to further build our Bangalore capability. The team uses Incentives Hub to operationalize incentive assessments, workflow management, and stakeholder collaboration in a structured digital environment. Incentives Hub (formerly myGi) is Deloitte’s technology-enabled platform for managing the incentive lifecycle more efficiently and transparently. The platform is designed to support the identification, assessment, tracking, and administration of incentive opportunities by combining tax and business process requirements with structured workflow, documentation, collaboration, and reporting capabilities. By connecting multiple stakeholder groups and providing access to a broad library of global incentive programs, Incentives Hub helps teams make more informed decisions, improve process consistency, and support compliant execution. This role will play a key part in shaping how the platform is enhanced and adopted for UK R&D relief and related tax technology use cases. What we’re looking for We are looking for a Business Analyst to support the adoption and implementation of a tax technology tool that performs UK R&D Relief / RDEC analysis. The role will sit between the technology development team and the business/project team, including colleagues who are client-facing, and will be responsible for translating business needs, tax process requirements, and regulatory expectations into clear functional requirements, user stories, process designs, and test scenarios. This is a hands-on delivery role for someone who is comfortable working across tax, operations, product, and engineering teams and can help ensure the platform is compliant, usable, and scalable. The successful candidate will help shape how the tool supports RDEC analysis within the current UK R&D tax relief framework, such as the merged regime effective for accounting periods starting on or after 1 April 2024, associated data capture requirements, and HMRC-oriented workflow needs such as digital filing support, pre-notification, and additional information requirements. department: Deloitte & Touche Assurance and Enterprise Risk Services India Private Limited
jobDescription: Consultant, Strategic Relationship Management | Enterprise Portfolio Management (EPM) We are looking for a detail-oriented, curious, and data-driven Senior Analyst who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative and hybrid work environment. This role sits within the USI EPM Audit & Assurance team and focuses on guiding account teams and business leaders through cross-functional strategic decisions that strengthen the firm’s position in an increasingly interconnected marketplace operating in a complex regulatory landscape. The team’s objective is to maximize value for the firm while supporting world-class businesses by informing and shaping how the firm can best serve clients in a continually evolving market. The ideal candidate will bring experience in market research and benchmarking, data analytics, database management, and reporting metrics, along with a strong understanding of professional services firms. Work you’ll do In this role, you will play a key role within the EPM Audit & Assurance team, partnering closely with the USI Executive Manager and US stakeholders on various data analysis, project management and reporting projects, while also supporting the broader EPM team in identifying and managing cross-business matters that impact Deloitte’s multi-disciplinary model of operating three world-class businesses under one ‘Deloitte’ brand. This role is suited for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment and can manage a diverse set of responsibilities with diligence and initiative. The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, adaptable to ambiguity, and responsive to feedback, with the ability to quickly refine approaches and develop practical solutions. You will leverage strong secondary research capabilities to identify trends, flag exceptions, and surface potential risks, while effectively managing multiple priorities. Success in this role requires the ability to work both collaboratively within the team and independently based on the specific needs of the project. You’ll be expected to • Develop a strong understanding of firm systems and leverage data to conduct due diligence on potential cross-business conflicts. • Build proficiency in team-specific tools and databases, applying them effectively across workstreams. • Gather and analyze data to support EPM A&A initiatives, particularly in identifying potential MDM situations and mitigating future risks. • Synthesize research insights and data trends into clear, structured narratives, demonstrating strong storytelling and logical flow. • Support both recurring and ad hoc reporting requirements for leadership. • Develop a strong understanding of Independence rules applicable to professional services firms and apply this knowledge to effectively support EPM activities and deliverables. • Proactively identify system issues or bugs and communicate them to relevant stakeholders. • Contribute innovative ideas and leverage best practices to enhance team efficiency and outcomes. The Team EPM’s mission is to guide the account teams and businesses through cross-business strategic decisions to optimize the firm’s position as the firm serves the clients in today’s increasingly interconnected marketplace and complex regulatory environment. The ultimate objective is to maximize value for the firm while maintaining world-class businesses by informing and shaping how the firm can best serve the clients in the evolving marketplace. EPM operates firmwide to prevent voids that block opportunities for growth. There are short-term aspects (e.g., optimizing day-to-day opportunities), and there are long-term aspects (e.g., harmonizing our business strategies and modifying our business investments to factor in the regulatory landscape). Ultimately, EPM enhances the ability to operate more effectively as one integrated firm. Location - Hyderabad Shift Time - 11:00 am - 8:00 pm IST Qualifications Required : • Master’s degree in business management (MBA, PGDBM), preferably with a specialization in Finance or Marketing. • 1-5 years of prior relevant experience in secondary research, data analysis and visualization. • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word and experience in creating data charts, flow diagrams, and dashboards. • Familiarity with secondary research databases such as PitchBook, Hoovers, Thomson Reuters, and S&P Capital IQ, along with exposure to CRM tools like Salesforce. • Strong analytical and data management skills, with the ability to synthesize insights, draw logical conclusions, and support reporting and dashboarding needs. • Excellent communication skills, including strong reading comprehension and the ability to clearly articulate ideas in both written and verbal formats.

jobDescription: Enterprise Performance Our Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to support the delivery of holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. We support Deloitte client service teams of strategic advisors and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to help collaborate with leading insights providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable the heart of business solutions Position Summary Level: SAP FPSL Functional Consultant We are seeking an SAP FPSL Functional Consultant to support the design, configuration, implementation and post-go-live operations of SAP S/4HANA for Financial Products Subledger. You will work with finance, actuarial and technical teams to translate regulatory accounting requirements, including IFRS 17, IFRS 9, US GAAP and multi-GAAP reporting, into effective subledger solutions for banking and insurance clients. What You Will Do · Configure and implement SAP FPSL - Set up the source data layer, accounting rules engine, and result data layer. Configure multi-GAAP capabilities, including Central GAAP / Delta GAAP and subledger posting logic for financial instruments and insurance contracts. Support accounting and measurement requirements - Assist with accounting configurations and reporting support for IFRS 17, IFRS 9, US GAAP and other multi-GAAP requirements. For IFRS 17, support the three measurement models: General Measurement Model (GMM), Premium Allocation Approach (PAA), and Variable Fee Approach (VFA), including related concepts such as CSM, risk adjustment, fulfillment cash flows and discounting. For IFRS 9, support accounting and reporting requirements related to classification and measurement, expected credit loss (ECL), amortized cost, fair value through other comprehensive income (FVOCI), fair value through profit or loss (FVTPL) and impairment/provisioning. Manage FSDP integration and data mapping - Map actuarial, policy and transactional data into SAP FSDP. Ensure clean data flow from source systems into FPSL. Support period-end close and GL integration - Assist with subledger journal entry creation, aggregation and GL transfer. Execute period-end steps and perform subledger-to-GL reconciliation. Support testing, defect management and go-live activities - Prepare test scripts and data, execute SIT, support UAT, analyze defects with ABAP/data teams and provide hypercare and production support. Engage stakeholders and document solutions - Participate in client workshops and requirement-gathering sessions. Produce functional specifications, process flows and configuration documentation. The Team: At Deloitte, our consultants cover all tasks within the supply chain utilizing consulting skills, business knowledge, and SAP solution expertise to effectively integrate SAP technology into the client’s business environment in order to achieve client expected business results. Our team members work collaboratively and apply their specialized knowledge and experience to help clients in standardizing global operations and streamlining processes. We offer deep insights into their business practices and procedures and help them to enhance their business’ efficiencies. Qualifications: Must have Skills: 3-6 years of SAP functional experience, with hands-on SAP FPSL exposure across at least one full implementation. Strong understanding of SAP FPSL architecture - Source data layer, accounting rules engine and result data layer and its integration with SAP S/4HANA General Ledger. Working knowledge of IFRS 9, IFRS 17, US GAAP and multi-GAAP concepts, including accounting and reporting requirements across these frameworks. Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA Financial Accounting (FI), including general ledger, chart of accounts, document types and GL posting integration. Experience in financial services - banking, insurance/reinsurance, or fintech is strongly preferred. Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate complex accounting requirements into SAP configuration, with clear communication across finance, actuarial and technical teams. Good to have Skills: Basic ABAP debugging skills for troubleshooting processing or posting issues. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum delivery models. title: RTR-RR- Manager
department: Deloitte & Touche Assurance and Enterprise Risk Services India Private Limited
location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India
jobDescription: Finance Transformation Join our Finance Transformation practice to help Deloitte client service teams define and execute Finance and Global Business Services agendas and strategies. You will work with world-class teams and insights, helping support delivery in challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to help unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we collaborate with teams to enable transforming finance. Finance Operate – Manager (Revenue Recognition & RTR) Role Description: As a Manager in the Finance Operate practice, you will take a leading role in ensuring accurate and compliant revenue recognition under US GAAP, while overseeing broader Record-to-Report (RTR) operations as required. This position works closely with client operations leaders, cross-functional teams and internal stakeholders to manage revenue documentation, financial close activities and service delivery, ensuring integrity of financial records and adherence to relevant policies and standards. Role Objective: This role sits within Deloitte's Finance Transformation – Finance Operate team, which provides operate-related support to clients across industries. The primary focus of this position is Revenue Recognition, where the Manager will be responsible for leading the review and governance of complex contracts and revenue transactions to ensure proper recording under US GAAP. Where required, the role will also provide senior oversight across RTR workstreams, managing teams and client relationships in line with contractual SLAs and business needs. Work You Will Do: Revenue Recognition (Primary Focus): • Lead the review and interpretation of a significant volume of legal contracts, supporting documents and correspondence to verify that documentation adequately supports revenue recognition under US GAAP, including transactions of varying complexity. • Oversee the analysis of individual revenue transactions to ensure revenue is properly documented and recorded in accordance with company policy and US GAAP standards (ASC 606). • Establish and maintain adherence to internal accounting policies, processes and procedures relating to revenue recognition; act as a senior point of guidance for the team. • Identify, analyse and resolve complex revenue recognition issues and/or conflicts; recommend and implement corrective action to minimise risk and ensure compliance. • Govern documentation frameworks to support internal and external audit requirements; manage audit queries related to revenue transactions. • Build and maintain strong relationships with internal clients and senior stakeholders; manage routine and non-routine queries, providing timely, high-quality responses. • Provide an 'Operate-to-Transform' lens on revenue recognition processes — identify opportunities for automation, standardisation and efficiency improvements. Record-to-Report (RTR – Additional Scope as Required): • Demonstrate in-depth understanding of accounting principles, rules, policies and procedures to ensure appropriate accounting and reporting across RTR workstreams. • Review the end-to-end R2R process, including general ledger accounting, period-end close, monthly and quarterly reporting, balance sheet reconciliations, journal entries, financial consolidation, statutory and management reporting, tax accounting and audit support, ensuring compliance with US GAAP. • Own end-to-end service delivery for one or more finance process towers within R2R across • Drive operational efficiencies in the financial close and reporting process through sustainable, technology-enabled solutions; identify and implement automation and process improvement opportunities. • Manage client relationships at Operations Leader level: run weekly governance calls and quarterly business reviews (QBRs), handle audit queries and partner with BD teams on change orders or new-scope proposals. • Design 'to-be' processes, target operating models and digital solution architectures; oversee delivery through internal CoEs and third-party vendors. • Lead, coach and develop high-performing teams of 15–20 FTEs: workforce planning, goal setting, performance reviews, succession and capability development. Must Have Skills / Experience / Certifications: • ACA / ACCA / CIMA qualified (or equivalent such as CA/CMA/CWA). • 8+ years of post-qualification experience, with demonstrable expertise in Revenue Recognition under US GAAP (ASC 606); experience in RTR/finance operations is an advantage. • Strong knowledge of US GAAP, particularly revenue recognition standards; knowledge of the real estate services industry and terminology preferred. • Able to read, analyse and interpret financial reports, complex legal contracts and business documents. • Experience working in a high-volume transaction environment with a results-driven mindset. • Shared Services Centre (SSC) / BPO experience. • Controls and compliance knowledge across R2R; SOX/IFC/GDPR-ready. • Client operations leadership: ability to run governance forums, QBRs and manage senior stakeholder relationships. • Team leadership: experience leading and developing teams of 15–30 colleagues across multiple geographies. • Excellent written and oral English communication skills; strong facilitation, presentation and stakeholder management capabilities. • Strong IT skills including Microsoft Excel (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, formulas etc.); Oracle PeopleSoft knowledge advantageous. • ERP/Finance tools exposure: Oracle, SAP, Blackline, Infor, Coupa, Cognos, Acadia 6.5 or similar. Good to Have Skills / Experience / Certifications: • Operate-to-Transform / due diligence experience: future-state solutioning, capacity and cost modelling, benefit case creation. • PMO / project management experience (3–4 years preferred). • Big 4 / BPO transition experience; experience leading transitions from external vendors. • Automation and digital capabilities: RPA, GenAI, predictive analytics; process automation identification and implementation. • Oracle / SAP certifications or automation tool certifications. Education: • Qualified CA / CMA / ACA / ACCA / CIMA or equivalent. Location and Work Timings: • Position is based in Hyderabad or Chennai. • Ability to work flexibly and extend hours as per business requirements.

jobDescription: We are seeking a Senior - Release Compliance Management professional to support the Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC) within Deloitte Tax in India. In this role, you will help drive release compliance activities across the software lifecycle by coordinating governance approvals, tracking readiness milestones, and supporting controlled release execution. You will work with cross-functional stakeholders across product, engineering, quality, risk, privacy, cyber, legal, and business teams to help enable timely, well-documented, and audit-ready software releases. This role is suited for a professional who can manage multiple compliance workstreams, escalate risks clearly, and improve release governance processes in a global environment. Work you'll do As a Senior - Release Compliance Management on the Global Employer Services Technology Center team, you will be responsible for: Coordinate required compliance approvals for software releases, including quality, risk, data privacy, cyber, and business governance signoffs. Gather and track release documentation, control evidence, risk inputs, approval artifacts, and closure records from product domain teams and control stakeholders. Support release readiness reviews, governance checkpoints, and go/no-go meetings by monitoring milestones, open issues, blockers, and mitigation plans. Partner with product, engineering, quality assurance, security, privacy, operations, legal, and business teams to confirm release deliverables meet software development lifecycle control requirements. Maintain compliance trackers, dashboards, and executive status reporting for approval status, risks, dependencies, decisions, and upcoming governance milestones. The team The Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC) supports technology-enabled tax operations by combining tax domain knowledge with digital, product, and delivery capabilities. The team works across a global stakeholder landscape to help design, build, govern, and support technology solutions that improve tax processes and user outcomes. Within this environment, the release compliance function helps teams navigate governance requirements while supporting timely and controlled delivery. Location: Hyderabad Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM Qualifications Required: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or Business 5+ years of experience in a project management office, compliance project management office, technology governance, release governance, or strategy consulting environment Experience using Azure DevOps, JIRA, or similar software development lifecycle tools to track milestones, approvals, risks, and dependencies Experience coordinating compliance approvals across quality, risk, data privacy, cyber, engineering, quality assurance, operations, and business stakeholders Experience maintaining compliance trackers, release dashboards, approval artifacts, audit evidence, and RAID logs Knowledge of software secure development lifecycle governance, release readiness controls, approval checkpoints, and evidence management Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Project, SharePoint, Teams, or similar collaboration tools Preferred: Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or progress toward certification Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification or progress toward certification Experience working in a regulated technology environment with formal approval gates, audit evidence requirements, and production release governance Knowledge of SOC 2, International Organization for Standardization 27001 (ISO 27001), General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), data privacy, cyber risk, and technology control frameworks

title: Senior, Tax Services-CBC-Insurance-Hyderabad
department: Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited
jobDescription: Position Summary Do you have a passion to work for U.S. based clients of Deloitte Tax and help transform their current tax practice to the next generation of tax functions? Are you ready to take the next step in your career, and find new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations? Are you ready to fulfil your potential, and have a significant impact on global initiatives? If the answer to all the above is "Yes," come join the Business Tax Services group in Deloitte India (Offices of the U.S.), a service line of Deloitte Tax LLP! Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited ("USI Tax") commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP ("Deloitte Tax") U.S. service lines have obtained support through the USI Tax teams. Deloitte Tax is leading its clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace, offering a broad range of fully integrated tax services by combining technology and tax technical resources to comply with the reporting requirements, uncover insights and deploy approaches for navigating an increasingly complex global environment. Work you'll do As a Tax Manager within the Business Tax Services Insurance group, you will be responsible for: • Maintaining and developing strong client relationships on various federal tax consulting/compliance engagements within the insurance industry. • Overseeing complex federal tax compliance and consulting projects requiring tax analysis for a variety of entities and their affiliates and ensuring the integrity of tax results using technology solutions, as well as supporting the development and implementation of tax strategies and planning opportunities. • Managing engagement workflow, engagement team resources, and engagement billing while providing leadership, counseling, and career guidance for the development and motivation of the engagement team. • Consulting with other service lines and peers to address tax issues and meet organizational objectives; particularly in the areas of international tax, state tax, transfer pricing, investments tax and M&A. • Staying abreast, and educating others, of trends and developments within the insurance industry. • Delivering professional and timely services to internal and external customers. The Team At Deloitte, our tax consultants provide a full-range of tax services to clients. We help our clients combine tax data, processes, technology, and people in new ways to uncover valuable business insights and arrive at smarter solutions to business challenges. Our team members work collaboratively and apply their specialized knowledge and experience to help clients navigate past complex tax and financial reporting issues. We offer deep insights into their business practices and procedures and help them make more informed decisions to enhance their business’ efficiencies. Learn more about Deloitte Tax.. The Caribbean and Bermuda Countries member firm tax professionals who work in the US business tax practice are based in Bermuda, the Cayman Islands, and the Virgin Islands. This team of 30+ permanent professionals ranges in grades from Partner to new tax consultant who are trained as US Certified Public Accountants, IRS Enrolled Agents, bar-admitted lawyers and/or master’s degree graduates, and serves a client base consisting of a range of financial services industry clients, including hedge funds, private equity funds, fund-of-funds, and insurance companies. Location: Hyderabad Qualifications Required: • 5-8 years of experience • Bachelor’s degree in accounting, taxation, finance, or commerce • Strong technical knowledge of U.S. insurance taxation • Proven experience managing tax compliance and advisory engagements for insurers, reinsurers, and captive insurance companies • Experience with Forms 1120, 1120-PC, 1120-L, consolidated tax returns, and ASC 740 • Excellent communication skills and a strong client relationship focus • Ability to lead teams, deliver in high-performance environments, and support in-house training initiatives Preferred: • US Certified Public Accountant credential • Internal Revenue Service Enrolled Agent credential • Bar admission in a US jurisdiction • Master’s degree in taxation or accounting
